lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters are organized into approximately 7-8 vertical columns posterior to the gill region. Each column contains 5-6 primary nodes, forming a rectilinear grid with uniform vertical and horizontal spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot alignments, creating a visible lattice-like structure across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges run parallel along the lateral-dorsal interface. These features are characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with specular highlights on the superior surface and shadow-casting on the inferior surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of micro-spots, characterized by significantly smaller diameters and tighter spatial clustering relative to the primary flank constellation.
